note: Both sets lean heavily on vague entities like "dimension" and "component," but Set A captures more genuinely supported facts: the 3/8" through bolt, the L3X3X1/4 support angle, the 1 1/2"=1'-0" scale, and correctly bound segment lengths (3'-8 3/8" leftmost of Module B, 2'-11 7/8" rightmost of Module A). Set B misbinds 2'-3 7/8" and 7 1/16" and invents unsupported property names (web thickness, flange thickness, top offset, internal offset, internal vertical spacing) while repeating the same 6", 1 1/2", 2" and 4 3/4" values under conflicting attributes. Set A's clear error is assigning 2'-3 7/8" to Module B (it belongs to Module A) plus a few invented bindings ("component B" width, center-to-center spacing) and one duplicate 3" base-block width. Neither set is strong, but A is more faithful and omits fewer key facts.
